_note: Demo disclosure library (PRD F8). owner and versions[].by are user names; versions are newest first. Rules refer to these IDs.

disclosures.title: Personal loan APR range and term
disclosures.text: APR = Annual Percentage Rate. Rates from 8.99% to 24.99% APR, based on creditworthiness. Loan terms from 12 to 60 months. Example: a $10,000 loan at 12.99% APR for 36 months has a monthly payment of $336.87.
disclosures.placement: Directly after the first rate or payment amount, in the same size as the body text.

disclosures.title: Cash back card rewards terms
disclosures.text: Cash back is paid as a statement credit each quarter; some purchases do not earn rewards, see the rewards terms.
disclosures.placement: Directly below the reward amount. Affiliates must not shorten it.

disclosures.title: Federal insurance statement
disclosures.placement: On every ad except loan-only ads and short radio ads. Use the official NCUA sign where there is space.

disclosures.title: Savings APY terms
disclosures.text: APY = Annual Percentage Yield. APY is accurate as of the date shown and can change after the account is opened. You need a minimum balance of $100 to earn the APY. Fees can reduce earnings.
disclosures.placement: Next to the first APY, or linked from it with a footnote mark.

disclosures.title: Auto loan APR and term
disclosures.text: Rates from 5.49% APR for terms up to 72 months, based on creditworthiness, vehicle age and mileage. Not all applicants qualify for the lowest rate.

disclosures.title: Rate check and credit score
disclosures.text: Checking your rate uses a soft credit inquiry and does not affect your credit score. If you apply, we use a hard inquiry, which can affect your score.
disclosures.placement: Next to any "check your rate" claim.
